facts.what: 照镜子认不出过去的自己
facts.anchor: She stares at the ghost reflected in the bathroom mirror.

facts.what: 喉咙生疼仍吃他做且配给的饭，吞咽困难
facts.anchor: Her throat is raw, but she must still try to eat whatever he cooks.

facts.what: 曾以爱令她晕眩，如今设下新规则
facts.anchor: But life is very different now, and she has so many rules to follow that didn’t exist in the beginning.

facts.what: 每天早晨六点、一周七天按闹钟起床
facts.anchor: The alarm that woke her this morning, set for six o’clock, seven days a week, is just one example of far too many.

facts.what: 持红色塑料笔想写日记，朋友家人因他而离散
facts.anchor: Or who she’s even talking to; her friends and family are long gone, thanks to him.

facts.what: 闻钥匙开锁声，把日记裹进破格纹茶巾并藏回去
facts.anchor: She quickly jumps from her perch on the edge of the bath and wraps the journal back up in the ragged checked tea towel.

facts.what: 被迫挤出笑容面对他，决定寻找出路
facts.anchor: She can feel her puppet master getting closer and his strings begin to tug the corners of her lips until a pretty smile is stretched from ear to ear.

relations: 匿名女性与未具名男子曾有初恋般亲密，现受其规则控制；身份尚未揭示
